The '''''Majestic''''' was the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of the [[Quara/Legends|Quara]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Pyash Yopayomba]].<ref name="Ando" />

It was colored black and augmented with [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsor]] fins that were often mistaken for sails. It was destroyed when [[Sissalik]] rammed the ''[[Nanda's Luck]]'', which was filled with explosives, straight into the ''Majestic''.<ref name="Ando" />
